title: Follow-Up Request Credit on the Optional Coverage Add-Ons Visit Fee
content:
A follow-up credit is taken off the rider visit fee of an Optional Coverage Add-Ons rider service request when the same rider has had another recent service request:

| Another rider service request on the same rider, placed less than one whole month before the day the fee is charged | Follow-up credit |
|---|---|
| One in the same trade as the request being charged | USD 40.00 |
| None in the same trade, but one in a different trade | USD 15.00 |
| None | None |

The request being charged is never counted as another request. Only requests on the same rider count.

## Boundary dates (hypothetical, fee charged on 20 June)

| Other request in the same trade placed on | Whole months to 20 June | Counts |
|---|---|---|
| 25 May | 0 | Yes: USD 40.00 credit |
| 21 May | 0 | Yes |
| 20 May | 1 | No |

**Hypothetical case.** A septic request is being charged; the only other request on the rider in the past month was in the well pump trade: the credit is USD 15.00.
